INDUSTRIES WE SERVE

Expertise in your sector.

Select a sector to view our support.

Software & Information Technology

Navigating the tax and regulatory landscape of the digital economy requires specialized knowledge. From structuring cross-border IT contracts and managing intellectual property taxation to ensuring seamless GST compliance for software services, we deliver precise, tech-forward financial solutions that protect your margins and support rapid scaling.

Engineering

Capital-intensive engineering businesses need more than routine bookkeeping. We deliver specialized financial structuring with a focus on works contract taxation, inventory management, and regulatory compliance. We streamline your financial workflows so your team can focus entirely on executing complex engineering projects.

Travel & Hospitality

We provide targeted financial structuring for the travel and hospitality sector. From navigating complex GST rules for travel agents to managing cross-border transaction compliance and operational audits, we ensure your financial backend is as seamless as the experiences you offer your clients.

Education

We deliver specialized financial oversight for schools, colleges, and educational trusts. From managing complex regulatory audits and FCRA compliances to optimizing institutional tax exemptions, we streamline your financial backend and ensure complete statutory adherence.

Banking & Financial Services

We deliver specialized risk management and compliance services for the banking and financial sector. From executing detailed concurrent audits to navigating complex RBI regulatory frameworks and capital structuring, we provide the robust financial reporting that financial institutions require to operate securely.

NGOs & Public Trusts

We provide complete financial structuring and compliance management for non-profits, societies, and charitable trusts. From navigating complex Charity Commissioner filings to securing vital tax exemptions and executing detailed audits, we ensure your organization remains fully compliant and funding-ready.

Hospital & Healthcare

We deliver specialized financial structuring for the healthcare sector. From navigating intricate GST exemptions on medical services to managing consultant payout compliances and pharmacy audits, we ensure the financial and regulatory operations of your hospital or clinic are executed with complete precision.

Maritime & Transportation

We deliver robust financial structuring for the maritime, logistics, and transportation sectors. From managing complex GST frameworks for GTAs to navigating cross-border freight taxation and operational fleet audits, we ensure your financial reporting remains accurate at every stage of the supply chain.

Builders & Developers

We deliver targeted financial structuring and compliance management for the real estate sector. From executing RERA audits and navigating Joint Development Agreements to managing the complex GST implications of under-construction vs. completed properties, we ensure your ventures are tax-efficient and strictly regulatory-compliant.

Manufacturing, FMCG & Agri-Tech

Manufacturing & FMCG

The manufacturing sector requires rigorous control over inventory, supply chains, and capital expenditure. We provide specialized advisory on factory compliance, complex GST input tax credit (ITC) reconciliations, and inventory valuation. Our robust financial oversight helps optimize your production costs and ensures seamless regulatory adherence from procurement to distribution.

Agriculture & Agri-Tech

The agricultural sector is modernizing rapidly, bringing new financial opportunities and regulatory requirements. We assist agro-processing units, cooperatives, and Agri-Tech startups with navigating specialized tax exemptions, export incentives, and supply chain financing. Our tailored advisory ensures your agribusiness remains profitable, compliant, and ready for expansion.

Retail, E-Commerce & D2C

Retail and e-commerce move at lightning speed, demanding dynamic financial tracking and strict marketplace compliance. We assist D2C brands, aggregators, and omnichannel retailers with high-volume transaction reconciliations, multi-state GST filings, and TCS/TDS compliance. We streamline your backend accounting so you can focus entirely on scaling your customer base.

Startups & Emerging Enterprises

Fast-growing startups need financial agility and investor-ready compliance. We guide founders through the entire lifecycle—from entity structuring and DPIIT registration to complex equity valuations and due diligence. We build scalable financial frameworks that protect your cap table and keep you compliant as you scale and secure funding.

USEFUL ANSWERS

Common questions.

Office & contact details
What services does PSB Associates provide?

P S B & Associates LLP provides audit and assurance, income tax and GST compliance, corporate advisory, business setup, accounting outsourcing, payroll, MIS reporting and virtual CFO services.

Does PSB Associates serve clients outside its office cities?

Yes. P S B & Associates LLP serves clients in India and abroad. Engagements are scoped around the client’s business, applicable requirements and professional obligations rather than a particular city.

Where are PSB Associates offices located?

The firm has offices in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Hingoli and Pune, Maharashtra. Office addresses and directions are available on the Contact page.

View more questionsView fewer questions
Does PSB work with startups and companies?

Yes. The firm supports startups, Indian and multinational companies, financial institutions, individuals, NGOs and public trusts. Engagement scope is agreed according to each client’s requirements.

Which industries does PSB Associates serve?

P S B & Associates LLP serves the following sectors: Software & Information Technology; Engineering; Travel & Hospitality; Education; Banking & Financial Services; NGOs & Public Trusts; Hospital & Healthcare; Maritime & Transportation; Builders & Developers; Manufacturing & FMCG; Retail, E-Commerce & D2C; Startups & Emerging Enterprises; Agriculture & Agri-Tech. Services include accounting, taxation, audit and advisory, for businesses and organisations in India and abroad.

How can I contact PSB Associates?

Email office@psbassociates.in or call +91 99224 12220. Office hours are Monday to Saturday, 10:30 AM to 7:30 PM IST.

Where does the PSB Briefing get its updates?

The Briefing checks the official GST, Income Tax, ICAI and RBI announcement sources. Each item links to its official source and shows the publication date when available. Refresh checks all four sources immediately; unavailable sources retain clearly marked previously checked information.
